safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states NKDA, but Generated has no explicit allergy/NKDA statement.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting an explicit NKDA statement can lead downstream clinicians to assume allergy status is unknown, potentially delaying prescribing or prompting unnecessary allergy verification. While it does not directly introduce a wrong allergy, it creates medication-safety ambiguity.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document non-smoking status and characterizing alcohol only as “a couple of times a week” has minimal impact on immediate management of suspected contact dermatitis and carries little direct safety risk. At most, it slightly reduces completeness of risk-factor documentation.
